title: M1 — Complete one supervised delegated task
description: Deliver the smallest assistant loop: accept a goal, form a bounded brief, select an enabled worker, report progress, answer a user status request and return evidence. One active worker per project initially. Build the common boundary once and verify each requested worker separately.
why: A vertical slice proves usefulness before adding a large agent framework.

acceptance.text: A user delegates one task through one conversation and can inspect the result

outcome.summary: Completed the supervised M1 delegation slice: a local Ollama assistant starts one bounded Codex task, returns its ID promptly, supports status/cancel/approval, and reports unverified worker output honestly.
outcome.verifiedBy: MAST-26, MAST-27, and MAST-28 complete; live local assistant-to-Codex read-only delegation returned and completed; follow-up status tool inspected the same task; 7 ACP tests, 15 task/policy tests, and TypeScript check passed.
